// Schema generation fallback
// Request: A fullstack Flashcard Hub application built with React, TypeScript, Express, and Prisma, featuring a Vercel-style dashboard for deck and card management, RESTful API endpoints with strict type safety, and an interactive mock test quiz module with performance analytics.

INFERRED FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS (implement ALL of these):
- Deck and Card Management Dashboard: A clean, Vercel-style UI displaying all user decks with card counts, creation dates, and quick action buttons for studying, editing, or deleting. [react, lucide-react, tailwindcss, clsx, tailwind-merge] (User navigates to dashboard → React queries Express GET /api/decks → Prisma fetches decks from database → JSON response renders grid of decks)
- REST API Backend with Prisma: Express server endpoints supporting CRUD operations for decks and cards, backed by a relational Prisma schema with PostgreSQL or SQLite. [express, @prisma/client, cors, dotenv] (HTTP request with payload → Express validates input → Prisma executes query on database → JSON response returned to client)
- Flashcard Editor and Creator: A modal or dedicated view allowing users to create and edit flashcards with markdown support, front/back text fields, and tagging. [react, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers] (User fills card form → Zod validates TypeScript schema → POST/PUT /api/cards endpoint called → Prisma updates database → UI updates optimistically)
- Interactive Mock Test Quiz Mode: A study mode that presents flashcards sequentially, tracks correct/incorrect answers, and displays a summary score upon completion. [react, canvas-confetti, framer-motion] (User starts quiz → Cards loaded into local state → User answers questions → State tracks score → Completion triggers confetti and saves session results)
- Strict TypeScript Safety and Validation: Shared TypeScript interfaces and runtime validation schemas ensuring type safety across the frontend, API requests, and Prisma database models. [typescript, zod] (Prisma schema generates types → Zod schemas validate API payloads → TypeScript enforces types across React components and Express controllers)

Required libraries: react, express, @prisma/client, typescript, tailwindcss, lucide-react, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, canvas-confetti, framer-motion, cors, dotenv, clsx, tailwind-merge

Feature folders: prisma, src/server, src/server/routes, src/server/controllers, src/client, src/client/components, src/client/pages, src/client/hooks, src/shared

Each feature listed above is REQUIRED. Do not omit any of them.
Implement every data flow end-to-end. No mocked data. No placeholder UI.


DESIGN SYSTEM — MANDATORY USAGE:
A design system has been pre-generated at src/design-system/.
You MUST import reusable components from there:
  import { Button, Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../design-system/index.js';

Design Language for this project: elegant (inspired by Linear/Vercel/Stripe)
Color palette: blue brand + slate neutral
Spacing: 8px grid (multiples of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16...)
Border radius: md (consistent across ALL components)
Font: Inter

FORBIDDEN UI PATTERNS:
  ✗ Different border radii on different components (e.g. some rounded-2xl, some rounded-lg)
  ✗ Arbitrary gradient backgrounds not matching the brand palette
  ✗ Buttons larger than 56px height
  ✗ More than 4 different font sizes in a single view
  ✗ Inconsistent spacing that breaks the 8px grid
  ✗ Excessive glassmorphism (max 1 blur panel per page)
  ✗ Missing hover/focus/active states on ANY interactive element
  ✗ Icon-only buttons without aria-label
  ✗ No visible focus indicator (outline-none without focus-visible replacement)

REQUIRED UI PATTERNS:
  ✓ Every interactive element has hover + focus-visible state
  ✓ Destructive actions show a confirmation step before executing
  ✓ Every async operation has a loading skeleton (not just a spinner)
  ✓ Every data-absent state has an EmptyState component with a call-to-action
  ✓ Error states show the actual error message + a recovery action
  ✓ All inputs have labels (visible or aria-label)
  ✓ Responsive at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px) breakpoints
